description: Which US listed ETFs hold a given company, ranked by how much of each fund it is. USE THIS for any "which ETFs hold X", "which fund holds the most X", or "how do I get exposure to X" question, where X is a company rather than a fund, and for "which bond ETFs hold X's debt". Takes a company name or its ticker. Returns every fund holding its shares with the weight its issuer published and the date that book was filed, and separately every fund holding its bonds or other debt. Covers 31,019 companies.
name: etf_holders
